stories.title: Bitcoin falls nearly 4% after Clarity Act fails Senate vote
stories.summary: Bitcoin extended its losses, dropping nearly 4%, after the Clarity Act failed a Senate vote, Investing.com reported. The bill was a piece of crypto market-structure legislation that investors had been tracking.
stories.whyItMatters: Crypto markets had priced in hope for clearer US rules, so the failed vote adds to regulatory uncertainty for bitcoin and related assets.
whatToWatch: Whether the Clarity Act is reintroduced or amended
Bitcoin's price action in the days after the vote
questions: Why did the Clarity Act fail to pass?

stories.title: Nasdaq, S&P 500 fall as 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2023
stories.summary: The Nasdaq and S&P 500 fell on September 14, 2026, as the 10-year Treasury yield climbed to its highest level since 2023, Yahoo Finance reported. Rising oil prices and tensions tied to the AI sector also weighed on stocks.
stories.whyItMatters: A multi-year high in the 10-year yield raises borrowing costs economy-wide and pressures growth stock valuations, including AI-linked names.
whatToWatch: Whether the 10-year yield keeps climbing
Oil price direction and any easing in AI-sector tensions
questions: What is driving the rise in the 10-year yield?
